lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.contract: MapFragment binds current MapDrawable ownership and starts/stops its resource watch with view lifecycle. Only actual remaining free system/Java headroom and OS low-memory state decide economy/work admission; nominal RAM class may choose ordinary disk-cache capacity and allocation reserve only, and absolute used/native/RSS counters remain diagnostics. Unknown counters are not zero free memory. Owner-fenced MapDrawable callbacks cross MaplibreMapInteraction back to MapFragment. MapRuntimeDiagnostics records bounded available RAM, Java headroom, system threshold/low-memory, free reserve and tile work limit alongside separate numeric process observations. There is no used/RSS target or enforced native cap, and no feature/geometry/visibility/data suppression is allowed.
